This is an Import Duty & Tax Calculator for cross-border shippers, not a marketing landing page. Keep a compact shared header with FreightVanta, Solutions, Industries, Insights, About, Contact, English and Request a shipment plan. Breadcrumb: Home / Tools / Import duty & tax. Create a single high-fidelity desktop web-app UI design canvas at exactly 1536x1024, edge-to-edge, no browser chrome/device frame/photo/charts. It is a FreightVanta Import Duty & Tax Calculator. Visual authority: compact white header, navy typography, cobalt blue buttons/actions, very pale blue-gray page background, hairline cool-gray borders, crisp modern sans-serif typography. Original calculator layout only; do NOT resemble or recreate a customs lookup detail page.

Header: white 80px height with left FreightVanta brand: cobalt square icon with simple ascending white logistics bars, wordmark FreightVanta in dark navy and tiny uppercase subtitle INTERNATIONAL LOGISTICS NETWORK. Center nav: Solutions (chevron), Industries (chevron), Insights, About, Contact. Right: globe icon, English (chevron), solid cobalt rounded button “Request a shipment plan”.

Main content max-width around 1280px, centered. breadcrumb small blue-gray: Home / Tools / Import duty & tax. Large dark navy title “Import Duty & Tax Calculator”; subtitle “Understand duties, import VAT and clearance costs before you ship.” To title right or below subtle outlined/light blue notice with bold small label “DESIGN PREVIEW” and text “Illustrative rates and amounts, not a customs assessment.”

Below create a clear two-column working layout, left 56% and right 44%, matching-height white cards with subtle borders and modest 10px rounding. LEFT CARD heading “Shipment details” and short intro “Enter your shipment values to build an illustrative estimate.” Fields compact and expertly spaced: a two-column grid for Destination [France with France flag/chevron] and Origin [China with China flag/chevron]; Import date [10 Nov 2026 with calendar icon] and Commodity code [6109100010], with a small helper / label “Example code” beneath or adjacent; a DDP / DAP segmented selector (DDP active cobalt); Currency [EUR dropdown]. Section divider and heading “Declared costs (EUR)”. Two-column amount fields with labels and aligned EUR formatting: Goods value 1,000.00; International freight 100.00; Insurance 10.00; Local delivery 20.00; Clearance service 30.00. At card bottom full-width cobalt primary button “Estimate import costs” with small arrow icon. Do not include any invalid or missing fields.

RIGHT CARD: top row heading “Estimated import costs” and compact pale-blue pill “Sample scenario”. Under it, a structured itemized cost panel with rows and fine dividers. Row: Customs value | EUR 1,110.00 (with small muted helper “Goods + international freight + insurance”). Then label/amount rows: “Example duty · 5%” | “EUR 55.50”; “Import VAT base” | “EUR 1,215.50”; “Example VAT · 20%” | “EUR 243.10”; “Clearance service” | “EUR 30.00”. Strong subtotal band: “Import charges” | “EUR 328.60”. Prominent pale blue total block: title “Landed cost” subtitle “Including goods and transport” and value “EUR 1,458.60” in large navy. Beneath: “Includes only the listed scenario costs. Final classification, additional measures and charges require confirmation.” Then full width cobalt action “Verify & request a quote”, followed by quiet text/button action with printer icon “Print summary”.

At bottom beneath cards, one horizontal white strip with three equally divided concise info blocks: “Calculation basis” with “Customs value, duty and VAT illustrated.”; “Data sources” with “Rates shown are examples for preview.”; “DDP vs DAP” with “Understand who manages import charges.” use tiny blue arrow indicators. Ensure canvas fits within 1536x1024 without a footer. Use clear visual hierarchy, realistic web form elements, accurate specified spelling/numbers, abundant but efficient white space. No marketing hero imagery, no graphs, no fraudulent live badges, no guarantee language.
